name: sound-tools
description: Real-time audio effects (distortion, reverb, filter) for any website, controllable with a MIDI controller.

scripts.build: npm run check-all && vite build --mode production
scripts.build:dev: npm run check-all && vite build --mode development
scripts.build:firefox: npm run check-all && vite build --mode firefox
scripts.build:firefox:dev: npm run check-all && vite build --mode firefox-development
scripts.build:all: npm run build && vite build --mode firefox
scripts.check-all: npm run type-check && npm run lint:check && npm run format:check
scripts.package: cd dist && zip -r ../sound-tools-extension.zip * && cd .. && echo 'Extension packaged as sound-tools-extension.zip'
scripts.prepare-publish: npm run build && npm run package
scripts.prepare-publish:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npm run lint:firefox && npm run package:firefox && npm run package:source
